source: Google Alert - Daily Digest uploaded for Silver Bull Radio test

items.headline: US Senate advances landmark crypto bill before heading on August recess
items.summary: The alert says Senate leadership moved to advance a major digital-asset market-structure bill, opening the next procedural stage before the August recess.

items.headline: XRP Ledger amendments target institutional adoption and tokenized assets
items.summary: The digest highlights privacy and institution-focused XRP Ledger changes aimed at tokenized financial assets, including a market with more than $530 million in tokenized Wall Street assets on the network.

items.headline: Wells Fargo announces tokenized deposit platform for select corporate and institutional users
items.summary: The alert says Wells Fargo announced a proprietary tokenized deposit platform scheduled for a fall 2026 launch for select corporate and institutional users.

items.headline: Bitcoin and ether ETFs draw $1.1 billion in their best inflow week since April
items.summary: The digest reports about $1.1 billion of combined bitcoin and ether ETF inflows, with bitcoin products recording inflows in all five sessions of the week.

items.headline: BlackRock's IBIT remains a major driver of the Bitcoin ETF inflow streak
items.summary: Several alerts point to BlackRock's IBIT as a major contributor to the latest five-day U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF inflow streak.

items.headline: Weak July jobs data shifts expectations around the Federal Reserve
items.summary: The digest includes coverage saying the weak July jobs report reduced expectations for a September Federal Reserve rate hike.

items.headline: Tokenized real-world asset deposits rise to $7.4 billion
items.summary: The digest says tokenized RWA deposits more than tripled to roughly $7.4 billion, led by tokenized Treasuries, funds, private credit, gold and equities.

items.headline: Tokenized Take-Two shares launch on Solana through Backpack's Sunrise platform
items.summary: The alert says Backpack Securities launched tokenized Take-Two shares on Solana through its Sunrise tokenization platform.

items.headline: BNB Chain RWA holders cross 300,000
items.summary: The digest reports that more than 300,000 wallets on BNB Chain now hold tokenized real-world assets.

items.headline: Circle focuses on Arc as a blockchain for institutional settlement
items.summary: The alerts describe Circle's Arc network as an institutional-settlement blockchain and highlight its potential role in USDC infrastructure.

items.headline: Tron adds about $2.2 billion in stablecoins over a 30-day period
items.summary: The digest says roughly $2.2 billion in stablecoins were added to Tron during the 30-day period ending August 4.

items.headline: Banks and stablecoins compete for a growing role in digital-dollar settlement
items.summary: The digest highlights stablecoins' growing use in trading, remittances, payments, DeFi and tokenized financial platforms, with one alert putting the broader stablecoin market above $300 billion.
